editorial.note: Samson escaped his murderers by wrenching apart the city gate of Gaza hinges and all, and running up the hill. In Heemskerk’s time this scene was considered as the forerunner (prefiguration) of Christ’s resurrection from the dead.
Boucher drew this beautiful female nude to use in a painting. That canvas is no longer known.

155428.title: Nude Woman Lying on a Pillow
155428.creator: Rembrandt van Rijn

editorial.note: The same woman apparently posed for this drawing and for the Nude Woman Seated by a Stove (nearby). She is recognizable by her hairstyle: it is not quite clear whether she is wearing a little cap or if her hair is done up in a bun.

155434.title: Kneeling Female Nude with Outstretched Arms
155434.creator: attributed to Aert de Gelder

editorial.note: Aert de Gelder made this nude study during his pupillage with Rembrandt. Like his master, his rendering of the posing woman with drooping breasts and a sagging stomach is unvarnished.

155435.title: Seated Female Nude with Raised Arms
155435.creator: attributed to Johannes Raven

editorial.note: A number of studies of nudes by Johannes Raven made in Rembrandt’s workshop are known. The model who posed for this drawing session can also be recognized in other sketches by him.

155441.title: Martyrdom of the Roman Officers John and Paul
155441.creator: Guercino

editorial.note: The degree of detail in this drawing indicates that Guercino had a very vivid idea of the beheading of John and Paul.
